subject: Prioritization & Team Boundaries: QBR prep + alignment request
messages:
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Cc: Diane Park <diane.park@pebbles-consulting.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Prioritization & Team Boundaries: QBR prep + alignment request

Hi team,

As we finalize the QBR deck, I want to lock in two things that leadership will be asked to endorse on Friday: (1) a narrowed set of company priorities for the next two quarters, and (2) proposed adjustments to team boundaries to reduce cross-team churn on infra/product work. 

Attached is a short proposal (QBR-priorities-v1.md) and an org-slice visual (2027-04-20_org_slice_chart.pdf). High-level ask: please review and reply with your position by end-of-day Thursday so we can fold feedback into the Exec readout on Friday.

Key highlights in the doc:
- Top priorities: 1) Serving reliability & SLOs, 2) Cost/perf hybrids for Dedicated, 3) Developer tooling for private deployments.
- Suggested re-balance: move platform feature ownership for "KV cache persistence" from Infra to Platform Reliability to improve rollout velocity.
- Proposed OKR delta: remove an exploratory objective and replace with a focused adoption objective for Dedicated customers (x% adoption target).

Two specific asks:
1) Marissa: assess operational impacts & customer messaging for the boundary change.
2) Karthik: confirm if the infra team can sustain current support levels if ownership shifts (estimate resource delta).

If you disagree strongly with the plan, say so — I want clear thumbs-up/downs and short rationale. We don't need long prose.

Thanks,
Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
VP, Product & Platform
Redwood Inference

Attachments:
- 2027-04-20_org_slice_chart.pdf (diagram)
- QBR-priorities-v1.md (markdown)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2027 12:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Prioritization & Team Boundaries: QBR prep + alignment request

Vivek — quick read and a couple of notes: I broadly support tightening focus on Serving reliability and the Dedicated adoption objective. A few quick items:

- The proposed move of "KV cache persistence" to Platform Reliability makes sense for customer rollout speed, but we need an explicit SLA handover doc for at least 6 weeks to avoid gaps. I can draft that and include a brief customer-facing blurb.
- On messaging: if we shift ownership, I suggest a short "what changes for customers" FAQ for CS and AE to use — I'll draft a 1-pager.

I'll flag one risk: the Platform Reliability team is already onboarding two mid-size Dedicated customers in May. Will need a 0.5 FTE buffer for the first quarter if we take that ownership now.

Thumbs: +1 support, pending the buffer.

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Head of Platform Strategy
Redwood Inference

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 21 Apr 2027 10:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Prioritization & Team Boundaries: QBR prep + alignment request

Vivek / Marissa — thanks for the clear asks. Quick operational note from Infra:

- Ownership shift is feasible but we should phase it. Suggest a two-week shadow period, then a four-week full handoff with clear runbook updates. That limits surprise incidents.
- Resource estimate: Marissa is right — we project ~0.4–0.6 FTE additional work for Platform Reliability for the first 8 weeks, then taper. We can absorb with contractors for the short term if leadership approves.
- Dependencies: the handoff requires finalizing the kernel selection checklist (I'll assign to Priya/Dev for completion by Apr 30).

Proposal: approve the boundary change with a phased handoff and an explicit buffer (0.5 FTE) in the Q2 resource plan.

Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Engineering Manager, Infrastructure
Redwood Inference

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 22 Apr 2027 17:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Prioritization & Team Boundaries: QBR prep + alignment request

All — OK from me. A couple of operational bullets for the QBR deck:

- Slide ask: include a single "impact table" that maps the boundary change to customer outcomes (latency, rollout time, support load). I'll work with Marissa to fill numbers.
- Approve the phased handoff and the 0.5 FTE buffer. We should call that out as a temporary cost in Q2 and show expected payoff by Q3.

I can incorporate these changes in the QBR deck tonight and share a clean version for review at 9am Friday.

Thanks — Stephanie
Stephanie Nguyen
Director, Business Operations (QBR owner)
Redwood Inference
